newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Three die, 16 wounded in blast in Manila home.
newsitem.headline: Three die, 16 wounded in blast in Manila home.

text.p: Three people died and 16 were wounded, some seriously, in an explosion on Wednesday that ripped through the ground floor of a house in the Philippine capital Manila, police said.
The ground floor of the three-storey building in a residential quarter was wrecked by the blast, which was apparently caused by a bomb, police sergeant Pedro Salazar said by telephone.
An investigation was continuing, he said,
Radio reports said earlier the explosion might have been caused by a leaking gas tank.
